description: Text to speech (TTS), OpenAI-compatible: generate speech from an OpenAI-shaped request with input, voice, model and response_format fields (WAV, FLAC or OGG). The model field is accepted and ignored; 10 base voices only, no personas. Use it for agents or apps built around /v1/audio/speech payloads. Costs $0.005 for 1-500 chars and $0.005 for 501-2000 chars. Charged only for a 200 that carries audio: the service refuses with 400 before payment (charged:false) text with no letter or digit, text whose script does not match lang, non-Latin text without lang, speed outside 0.7-2.0, steps outside 1-100, or an unknown voice, lang or response_format; audio that fails its post-synthesis check answers 502 with charged:false.

lang.description: Language code, default en for Latin-script text; must match the script of the text and is required for non-Latin text

model.description: Optional model field; accepted and ignored by the service

name: generate_openai_compatible_voice
title: Generate OpenAI-Compatible Voice
